## DataConfidenceExplanationButton

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Wpf.Controls.DataConfidenceExplanationButton</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Wpf/Controls/DataConfidenceExplanationButton.cs:14](../../../../src/Meridian.Wpf/Controls/DataConfidenceExplanationButton.cs#L14).

Button whose automation peer stops advertising an interactive Button/Invoke role while no command is bound: a read-only confidence badge must not present assistive technology with an action that does nothing. The click-through trigger nulls the command too, so the same check covers both read-only states. Pointer input follows the same rule: a commandless badge leaves mouse events unhandled so they reach a hosting row or card.

```csharp
public sealed class DataConfidenceExplanationButton : Button
```
